⚡ BoltBeam                                                                (•ᴗ•)
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Engine                                                                       │
│ The engine is the runtime that decodes the model. Only engines found on this │
│ Mac can be picked. They are looked for at start; an env var                  │
│ (BOLTBEAM_LLAMA_BENCH, BOLTBEAM_TINYGRAD_ROOT, …) overrides what was found.  │
│                                                                              │
│ 2 GPUs: 2 x AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (limited support: one real multi-GPU run │
│ so far (vLLM split by rows on two R9700s))                                   │
│ The layout is how the engine uses them; pick it under the engine:            │
│   one GPU: one GPU reads every weight                                        │
│   split by layer: holds a bigger model; the GPUs take turns, so no decode    │
│ speedup                                                                      │
│   split by rows: the GPUs read their shares at once; joins cost per layer    │
│                                                                              │
│ llama.cpp · can measure                                                      │
│   roles: not possible here (x)                                               │
│   split by rows not here: llama.cpp's HIP build refuses it at model load:    │
│ "device ROCm0 does not support split buffers" (llama.cpp 7182ef7, 2 x R9700) │
│ vllm · can measure                                                           │
│   roles: not possible here (x)                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Choose                                                                       │
│ llama.cpp · one GPU · roles not timed here                                   │
│ ▸ ● llama.cpp                                                                │
│       ● one GPU                                                              │
│         split by layer (2 GPUs)                                              │
│         split by rows: not here                                              │
│     vllm                                                                     │
│         one GPU                                                              │
│         split by rows (2 GPUs)                                               │
│         split by layer: not here                                             │
│     tinygrad                                                                 │
│         one GPU                                                              │
│         split by layer, split by rows: not here                              │
│     [ Scan again ] look for engines in the usual folders                     │
